name: scribe
description: Turn what a patient describes, or a clinical document they hand over, into structured medical records a human can check. Bundles the clinical-scribe skill + the hosted Scribe MCP server (scribe.maxhealth.tech), which validates every resource against its IPS profile and verifies codes against a real terminology server. Nothing is saved: each result is a draft for someone to accept. Sign in with your Max Health account on first use.

interface.shortDescription: Describe what happened, get back records someone can check.
interface.longDescription: Describe how you are feeling, or hand over a discharge summary, a lab report or a letter, and Scribe turns it into proper clinical records. Every resource is validated against its International Patient Summary profile and repaired until it passes, and codes are verified against a terminology server rather than recalled. Nothing is saved: what comes back is a draft for you or your clinician to look over, and anything read out of a document keeps that document attached as its source.
